name: IT team · M1 GO/NO-GO re-check at 12:45Z — reverse the NO-GO only if 200/302 evidence exists, otherwise confirm the fallback artefact
description:
WHY THIS CARD EXISTS
QA shift #16 (2026-11-25T12:10Z) issued **NO-GO** on the 13:00Z demo slot (card `de6906e4`, comment on `b9aaf03c`). The decision rule was applied literally: GO required `/api/health` = 200 **and** the landing/login page = 200/301/302, observed in `e586bfd2`. Neither code exists — the rehearsal turn was paused at max tool rounds with no container up, `demo/.env` missing and compose stuck on image fetch, followed by "two real conflicts".

That verdict is correct for 12:10Z but it is **not final for 13:00Z**: `b9aaf03c` wakes at 12:15Z and may produce the missing evidence before the slot. Nobody owns that re-read today (this is the gap this card closes).

DO, in this order, and be quick — the slot is at 13:00Z.
1. Read the latest comments on `e586bfd2` and `b9aaf03c` for evidence posted **after 12:10Z**. You need exactly two things: the HTTP status of `/api/health` and the HTTP status of `/` on http://localhost:19981/. Also useful, not decisive: `--list-providers` output, `./demo/up.sh` stdout, `docker compose ps`.
2. DECISION RULE (unchanged, do not soften it):
   - Both codes present and matching → **GO**. Post the reversal as ONE comment on `b9aaf03c`, quoting the two codes and their timestamp, and note who produced them.
   - Anything missing, or only prose ("it started fine") without a status code → **NO-GO stands**. Do not convert an unverified stack into a GO because the slot is close. Post a one-line comment on `b9aaf03c` confirming the NO-GO is unchanged.
3. If NO-GO stands, check the fallback: does `def4ce38` (recorded walkthrough, due 10:00Z, progress 0 at 12:10Z) now have an artefact — a video path, a screenshot set, or a pasted transcript in its comments? State plainly in the same comment whether the presenter has something to fall back on. If there is nothing, say so in one sentence; that is the honest state of the slot and the PM needs it in writing.

DO NOT: re-run the QA engine to re-measure the broken suites (deterministic, recorded in `de08e8d9` / `d0a8b091` / `f3e1dd0c`), edit product code, or move any card other than this one.

ACCEPTANCE
- One comment on `b9aaf03c` dated before 13:00Z that says, in its first line, either "GO — reversed" or "NO-GO unchanged", with the two HTTP codes if any.
- If NO-GO stands, a second sentence on whether the recorded fallback exists.
- Close this card with `progress: 100` either way.
